title: Simultaneous Detection of mRNAs and (Phospho-)Proteins with ARTseq-FISH in Mouse Embryonic Stem Cells
author: Hu, van Sluijs, et al.
materials: This step describes the blocking and antibody incubation procedures of ARTseq-FISH as a general immunofluorescence method. Blocking reduces the unspecific antibody binding.3.Add blocking buffer (equivalent volume to cell culture medium) to samples.4.Incubate for 1 h at room temperature (i.e., around 22°C–25°C).5.Incubate with ssDNA-conjugated antibody.a.Prepare antibody solution: dilute ssDNA-conjugated antibodies with a ratio of 1:4000 in blocking buffer.b.Remove the blocking buffer from the sample.c.Add 30 μL antibody solution per well.d.Incubate for 4 h at room temperature (i.e., around 22°C–25°C).CRITICAL: We have optimized the order of antibody incubation and the mRNA PLP hybridization. When combined, perform the antibody incubation first followed by the mRNA PLP hybridization for a better outcome.

steps.title: Block cells and incubate primary antibodies
steps.instruction: Perform blocking and primary antibody incubation as a standard immunofluorescence procedure for ARTseq‑FISH.

substeps.instruction: Add blocking buffer in a volume equal to the cell culture medium to each sample.
Incubate the samples for 1 hour at room temperature (≈22 °C–25 °C).
Prepare antibody solution by diluting ssDNA‑conjugated antibodies 1:4000 in blocking buffer.
Remove the blocking buffer from each sample.
Add 30 µL of the diluted antibody solution to each well.
Incubate for 4 hours at room temperature (≈22 °C–25 °C).

steps.title: Prepare cells for flow cytometry (optional)
steps.instruction: If downstream analysis will be performed by flow cytometry, detach, fix, permeabilize, and process cells according to the specified volumes and handling conditions.

substeps.instruction: Detach cells with trypsin before fixation.
Collect cells in an Eppendorf tube containing 1 mL fixation and permeabilization solution.
Add 200 µL of blocking buffer, antibody mix, or washing solution per tube as required for each step.
For reaction steps (steps 6, 12, 18, 23, 30, 39), add 150 µL of reaction solution per tube.
Place tubes on a shaker set to 50 cycles/min for all incubation and washing steps.
Perform all washing steps by centrifugation.
Use a 0.2 mg/mL BSA solution in PBS for every wash to prevent cell adhesion to tube walls.

After completing steps 1–43, measure samples on a flow cytometer using Alexa Fluor 488 (excitation 488 nm) and Alexa Fluor 647 (excitation 627–640 nm) lasers with 517/493 nm and 669/53 nm filters, respectively.
